_template_note: NON-AUTHORIZING TEMPLATE (C85). This file never verifies: the extra `_template_note` key fails the exact-schema check and every placeholder fails its form check. Only General Musashi may author the real record, at ~/.config/agent-multi/reviewer_authority/MUSASHI_T2_SUCCESSOR_EXECUTION_RECORD.json, mode 0600, after his own review. Satoshi never authors, installs, chmods or simulates it. The v6 execution-record pathname and schema are NOT reused: this record authorizes ONLY the resource successor, and a v6 record never authorizes the successor.
reviewed_at_date: <YYYY-MM-DD, canonical ISO date of the actual review>

successor_design_self_sha256: <64-hex internal design_sha256 of the successor (0542ed05... expected; reviewer re-derives, never copies)>

executor_code_identity.tools/t2_confirmatory.py: <64-hex per-file SHA-256 of the reviewed checkout — one entry per file of T2_EXECUTOR_CODE_SURFACE, reviewer-computed via conf.executor_code_identity()>
